note: The steps send the chat history to the client as AG-UI messages through `llama_index_message_to_ag_ui_message`, which gives a tool message without a `tool_call_id` a fresh `uuid4` as its call id. That message names no tool call, and the id comes back into the chat history on the next turn. The workflow is the AG-UI chat workflow that bugs/23-llama-index-22069 builds.

fixed.fix_note: From llama-index-protocols-ag-ui 0.3.3 the conversion raises for a tool message without a call id.
